name: crm-lifecycle-ops
description: The AI copilot for lifecycle & CRM operations on Braze, Klaviyo and Iterable: plan, build, check and change campaigns faster without breaking what's live.

braze_api_key.title: Braze REST API key
braze_api_key.description: Read-only key (campaigns, canvas, segments, content blocks: list/details/data). Leave blank if you don't use Braze.

braze_workspace.title: Braze workspace label
braze_workspace.description: Any short name, e.g. prod. Keeps snapshots of different workspaces apart.

klaviyo_api_key.title: Klaviyo private API key
klaviyo_api_key.description: A read-only private key. Leave blank if you don't use Klaviyo.

klaviyo_account.title: Klaviyo account label
klaviyo_account.description: Any short name for this account.

iterable_api_key.title: Iterable API key
iterable_api_key.description: A server-side key with read access. Leave blank if you don't use Iterable.

iterable_project.title: Iterable project label
iterable_project.description: Any short name for this project.

team_report_folder.title: Team report folder
team_report_folder.description: Optional: a shared folder (e.g. a synced team drive) where each operator's usage counts are mirrored, so /ops-report can show team totals. Counts and check ids only; never message content.
